Definition: Shaphat, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Shaphat = "judged" or "he hath judged"; 1) son of Hori and the prince of Simeon chosen to spy out the promised land; 2) father of the prophet Elisha; 3) a Judaite, son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel in the royal line of Judah; 4) a chief of the tribe of Gad; 5) son of Adlai and chief herdsman for David over the herds in the valleys
